process.description: We check all moving parts: springs, cables, rollers, hinges, and tracks. We look for wear, damage, and alignment issues.
We apply garage-door-specific lubricant to all appropriate moving parts, reducing friction and noise.
We adjust spring tension and opener travel limits as needed. We also tighten loose fastener hardware to ensure stability.
After work, we perform a balance test and an opener safety-reverse test. This ensures the door operates safely and correctly.
